Page numbers are 1-based PDF page indices. They equal Bosch's printed "N | 60". The cover and document history give revision 1.24 of February 2024 (ds p. 1, p. 59); the page footers still say "BST-BME280-DS001-23 Revision_1.23_012022". The URL is the one in `lib/@contrib/env/docs/README.md`; it names document `ds002`, not the shipped `DS001` (see "Not established").

## Summary

The BME280 measures relative humidity, barometric pressure and temperature in a 2.5 × 2.5 × 0.93 mm metal-lid LGA with a vent hole (ds p. 2). It runs from VDD 1.71–3.6 V with a separate VDDIO of 1.2–3.6 V for the interface (ds p. 8). It talks I²C (up to 3.4 MHz) at address 0x76 or 0x77, or 3- or 4-wire SPI (up to 10 MHz); CSB selects the interface at power-up (ds p. 2, p. 32). Current is 3.6 µA at 1 Hz with all three measurements and 0.1 µA in sleep (ds p. 2). Pressure is ±1.0 hPa absolute over 0–65 °C (ds p. 11) and humidity ±3 %RH (ds p. 9). Its pins are numbered clockwise in top view, unlike most packages (ds p. 38).

Checked pad by pad against the rendered Figure 16, Table 35 and the top-view land pattern Figure 21 (ds p. 43). `FP_Bosch_BME280_LGA8_2_5x2_5mm` puts pad 1 at (+1.025, −0.975) mm and runs clockwise to pad 8 at (−1.025, −0.975) mm, as the figures do. The package drawing (Figure 20, ds p. 42) shows the same package turned 90°, and its pin-1 corner and clockwise top-view order agree.

## Typical application

- I²C (Figure 17, ds p. 39): CSB tied directly to VDDIO (required); SDO to GND for 0x76 or VDDIO for 0x77; pull-ups R1, R2 on SDA and SCL, typically 4.7 kΩ; C1 and C2 100 nF on VDD and VDDIO.
- SPI 4-wire and 3-wire: Figures 18 and 19 (ds pp. 40–41), 100 nF on each supply; in 3-wire mode SDO is DNC (ds p. 38).
- SPI modes '00' and '11' are supported (ds p. 32).
- Interface selection: CSB high at power-on selects I²C; pulling CSB low once selects SPI and disables I²C until the next power-on reset (ds p. 32). If CSB comes from an MCU pin, that pin must already be at VDDIO during power-on reset (ds p. 32).
- Power-up: no restriction on slope or order of VDD and VDDIO (ds p. 14). Reset by cycling VDD or by soft reset; cycling VDDIO does not reset (ds p. 14).

## Layout notes

- Recommended land (Figure 21, ds p. 43), top view: 0.50 × 0.35 mm lands, 0.65 mm pitch, 0.325 mm from the horizontal centreline to the inner lands, 0.775 mm from the vertical centreline to the land inner edge, so land centres are ±1.025 mm and ±0.325 / ±0.975 mm. The library footprint uses exactly these values. It matches.
- Package (Figure 20, ds p. 42): 2.50 × 2.50 mm body, 0.93 ± 0.07 mm tall; 0.350 × 0.350 mm terminals, 0.65 mm pitch, 1.95 mm between rows; vent hole Ø 0.30 mm.
- Lands may be solder-mask defined or non-solder-mask defined; Figure 21 gives the exposed metal (ds p. 43).
- Keep ≥ 0.1 mm clearance above the metal lid, vent the housing to ambient for pressure, keep liquids and strong light off the sensor, and do not use vapour-phase soldering (ds p. 48).
- Solder height after reflow ≥ 50 µm; reflow peak up to 260 °C; MSL 1 (ds p. 45).
- After reflow, humidity readings need reconditioning, for example ≥ 5 days at ~25 °C and > 40 %RH (ds p. 46).

## Pitfalls

- Do not hold any interface pin high while VDDIO is off; the ESD diodes conduct and can damage the part (ds p. 14).
- SDO must not float in I²C mode; the address is then undefined (ds p. 33).
- A CSB low pulse after power-up (for example from a shared SPI bus) locks the part into SPI until the next power cycle (ds p. 32).
- SDI and SCL are not pure open-drain; both have ESD diodes to VDDIO and GND, and the part does not stretch the clock (ds p. 32).
- Pin numbering is clockwise in top view (ds p. 38); a generic counter-clockwise LGA-8 land would swap pins.
- Pressure readings shift with temperature by ±1.5 Pa/K (ds p. 11) and the sensor is light-sensitive (ds p. 48).

## Not established by the sources

The library pin numbers, names, clockwise order and land pattern agree with the data sheet (Figure 16 and Table 35, ds p. 38; Figure 21, ds p. 43). Gaps and disagreements:

- **Source URL and document number:** the README's URL ends in `bst-bme280-ds002.pdf`, but the shipped PDF is BST-BME280-DS001-24 (ds p. 1). Nothing in the repository ties that URL to this file.
- **Revision in the library comment:** `bme280.cohdl` says "BST-BME280-DS001-23 rev 1.23, January 2022". The shipped PDF is revision 1.24, February 2024 (ds p. 1, p. 59), whose only change is "Remove condensation" in chapter 2 (ds p. 59). Its page footers still read 1.23.
- **MPN:** the library MPN is the product name `BME280`; the data sheet gives sales part number 0 273 141 185 (ds p. 1) and no other ordering code.
- **Pin types:** Table 35 types SDO "In/Out" and CSB "In" (ds p. 38); the library marks CSB and SDO `required`, which matches the I²C and 4-wire SPI connection diagrams but not 3-wire SPI, where SDO is DNC (ds p. 38).
- **Courtyard:** the 3 × 3 mm courtyard is the library's own (its comment says so); the data sheet gives none.
- **Not given:** thermal resistance and a maximum operating humidity-temperature envelope beyond Figure 1 (ds p. 10).
